title: SanaCkoala
description:
[b]SanaCkoala[/b] adds two new playable characters to Slay the Spire 2, the Koala and the Panda. Both work in singleplayer, and they are built to play well together in co-op.

[h2]The Koala[/h2]
70 HP. Starter relic: [b]Eucalyptus Leaf[/b] (start each combat with 3 Drowsy). Touch of Orobas upgrades it to [b]Eucalyptus Crown[/b] (6 Drowsy).
[list]
[*][b]Drowsy[/b]: at the end of your turn, gain Block equal to your Drowsy.
[*][b]Waking up[/b]: some cards remove all of your Drowsy at once for a big effect.
[*]Three ways to play: keep stacking Drowsy and never wake up; stack it, then wake up for burst damage or Energy; or Retain cards that grow stronger the longer you hold them.
[/list]

[h2]The Panda[/h2]
80 HP. Starter relic: [b]Bamboo Basket[/b] (start each combat with 3 Bamboo). Touch of Orobas upgrades it to [b]Bamboo Hamper[/b] (6 Bamboo).
[list]
[*][b]Bamboo[/b] is a resource you gather with cards and powers.
[*][b]Munch N[/b]: if you have at least N Bamboo, the card spends it and triggers a bonus effect.
[*]Three ways to play: hoard Bamboo and munch it, turn Block into damage, or build Strength.
[/list]

Each character has 87 cards (3 Basic, 20 Common, 36 Uncommon, 26 Rare and 2 Ancient), the same split as the vanilla characters. Each also has seven relics and two potions on top of the starter relic.

[h2]Ancient cards and events[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Archaic Tooth[/b] turns Doze into Deep Sleep and Gather Bamboo into Bamboo Harvest.
[*][b]Dusty Tome[/b] gives the Koala Lazy Sunday and the Panda Rolling Thunder.
[*]Four events appear only in runs with the Koala or the Panda: Picnic for Two, Stargazing, Little Quarrel and Photo Booth.
[/list]

[h2]Co-op content[/h2]
In multiplayer runs, both characters start with [b]Hold Hands[/b], and five more colorless cards can appear: [b]Share a Bite[/b], [b]Quarrel[/b], [b]Make Up[/b], [b]Assist[/b] and [b]Promise[/b]. The Koala has five co-op cards of its own and the Panda has seven, such as [b]Wake-Up Kiss[/b], [b]Pajama Party[/b], [b]Piggyback Charge[/b] and [b]Partner in Crime[/b]. Each character also has a co-op relic, two shared relics can drop, and the Stargazing and Little Quarrel events need a second player. None of this shows up in singleplayer.

[h2]Installation[/h2]
[list]
[*]Requires [b]BaseLib[/b]. Steam asks you to subscribe to it as well.
[*]Subscribe and start the game. The first time, the game asks whether to load mods; allow it.
[*]For multiplayer, every player needs this mod on the same version.
[*]Do not also keep a manual copy in the game's [i]mods[/i] folder.
[*]Modded play uses a separate set of save files. Your unmodded saves are not touched. On a fresh modded save, the mod still starts act 1 with Neow.
[/list]

[h2]Compatibility[/h2]
Tested on game version v0.107.1 only. Other versions may not load.

Source code and full README: [url=https://github.com/PingChunChung/spire-duo]GitHub[/url]

Fan-made mod, not affiliated with or endorsed by Mega Crit. Card art, icons and character images made with AI image generation.
changeNote:
[b]v0.3.0[/b]
[list]
[*]Each character now has 87 cards (3 Basic, 20 Common, 36 Uncommon, 26 Rare, 2 Ancient), all with art.
[*]Each character has three playstyles, seven relics and two potions.
[*]Touch of Orobas upgrades the starter relics into Eucalyptus Crown and Bamboo Hamper.
[*]New Ancient cards from Archaic Tooth and Dusty Tome.
[*]Four new events: Picnic for Two, Stargazing, Little Quarrel and Photo Booth.
[*]The characters now have their own rest site, shop, energy orb and character select art.
[*]Reworked cards that played too much alike: Rude Awakening is now Wide Awake, Pincer is now Assist, and Dark Circles has a new effect.
[/list]
[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Neow no longer goes missing from act 1 on a fresh modded save.
[*]In co-op, the first chest no longer offers the same relic to two players.
[*]Relics now show "SanaCkoala" as their mod instead of "SpireDuo".
[*]Darv's Dusty Tome no longer causes an error for the Koala and the Panda.
[/list]
Every player needs to update before playing together.
Source and details: [url=https://github.com/PingChunChung/spire-duo]GitHub[/url]

[b]v0.3.0[/b]
[list]
[*]每個角色擴充到 87 張卡（3 張基本、20 張普通、36 張罕見、26 張稀有、2 張先古），每張都有卡圖。
[*]每個角色有三種玩法、7 個遺物和 2 瓶藥水。
[*]歐洛巴斯之觸會把起始遺物升級成尤加利花冠和野餐竹籃。
[*]新增先古卡，可從古老牙齒和積塵古籍取得。
[*]新增 4 個事件：雙人野餐、一起看星星、小吵架、大頭貼機。
[*]休息處、商店、能量球和選角畫面都換成角色專屬圖。
[*]重新設計玩起來太像的卡：大夢初醒改成新效果的技能卡，夾擊改名助攻，黑眼圈也換了效果。
[/list]
[b]錯誤修正[/b]
[list]
[*]全新的 mod 存檔，第一章不會再沒有 Neow。
[*]多人時，第一個寶箱不會再給兩位玩家同一個遺物。
[*]遺物的「來自模組」改成顯示 SanaCkoala，不再顯示 SpireDuo。
[*]達夫的積塵古籍不會再對無尾熊和熊貓報錯。
[/list]
多人連線前，每位玩家都要先更新。
原始碼與詳細說明：[url=https://github.com/PingChunChung/spire-duo]GitHub[/url]
